evidence.quote: At Hof University, no tuition fees are charged for our Bachelor's and Master's programs.
Für Austauschstudierende von Partnerhochschulen sowie Studierende in regulären Bachelor- und Masterstudiengängen.
You can apply for a preliminary documentation (VPD) year-round.

notes: The programme is a BEng at Hof University of Applied Sciences. Duration: 7 semesters equals 3.5 years. Teaching language: English; German A1 is required for admission, and German courses to B2 are integrated but not the teaching language. Tuition: no tuition fees are charged for Bachelor's and Master's programmes, as stated by the university's financing page. Application channel: foreign applicants with a non-EU school-leaving certificate must first have their documents reviewed by uni-assist and obtain a preliminary review documentation (VPD) before applying via the Primuss portal; the quote 'You can apply for a preliminary documentation (VPD) year-round.' supports this. Application deadline: the DAAD page states 'For the winter semester: 15 April - 15 July' valid for applicants from all countries; no year is given, so it is recorded as a recurring deadline (15 July). Documents: mandatory documents for non-EU applicants are taken from the application and admission page; translation requirements are not stated on the pages used, so translationRequired is null. Language requirements: English B2 (TOEFL 90 or IELTS 6.5) and German A1 are stated admission requirements; French is not mentioned.

evidence.quote: In addition: German language skills, proven by official test score documents - minimum level A1

note.fr: Vérifiez votre aptitude à l'entrée à l'université (Hochschulzugangsberechtigung) via la base de données anabin et le DAAD; si vous n'avez pas de qualification directe, un Studienkolleg peut être nécessaire.
note.en: Check your higher education entrance qualification via the anabin and DAAD databases; if you do not qualify for direct admission, preparatory studies (Studienkolleg) may be required.

evidence.quote: Not all school leaving certificates (= higher education entrance qualification) qualify for a direct entry at German universities .
